properties.description: Established in 1886, this historic professional football club serves as a central pillar of English football and global sports culture. Operating out of North London, the organization fields both men's and women's professional teams while maintaining a renowned youth academy. Its identity is defined by a deep commitment to excellence, a massive international fanbase, and a rich history of competitive success. The club engages fans through professional match play, digital storytelling, and a strong community presence.
properties.short_description: Arsenal F.C. is a professional football club based in London, competing in the English Premier League and known for winning 13 league titles.

short_descriptions.value: Un club de football historique et de renommée mondiale, reconnu pour son excellence compétitive constante et son lien profond avec la communauté du nord de Londres.
Un histórico y mundialmente famoso club de fútbol, conocido por su excelencia competitiva constante y su arraigada conexión comunitaria en el norte de Londres.

properties.description: A historic and highly successful professional women's football club based in North London. As part of a larger, long-standing football organization, the club is a prominent force in the Barclays Women's Super League and European competition. It combines a deep heritage with an ambition to define the future of women's football, regularly drawing large crowds to iconic stadium venues. Through its consistent performance and commitment to professional standards, it serves as a leader in the global movement toward professionalizing and expanding the reach of women's sports.

short_descriptions.value: Un pionero club de fútbol femenino profesional con sede en Londres, con una rica historia y un firme compromiso con la excelencia en el campo de juego.
